name: After § 78
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 78d. Strongly deplores and condemns any rhetoric, pressure or threats aimed at bringing Greenland under US control; calls for the EU, the VP/HR, the Commission and the Member States to react immediately, making clear that any attempt to undermine the sovereignty and territorial integrity of Denmark and Greenland would have serious political consequences and must be met with firm European solidarity;
